multilevel.gradient_budget_scope: fixed after initial L-only calibration using mean old-pair gradient norms; no current-batch adaptation
multilevel.aux_ce_routing: both heads fit by detached clean A/B features; no auxiliary CE to backbone
multilevel.routing_control: all heads warm200 on frozen L; fit both heads every4 active steps; auxiliary capture preserves identity RNG and dropout modes
multilevel.style_scope: extra L main identity CE at selected hooks; same TX/day, cross RX, different real PID; duplicate occurrences permitted

resolved.gradient_scope: full identity parameters and fixed shallow/middle parameter groups; actual autograd, no virtual-affine substitution
resolved.dropout_control: primary eval; secondary frozen-buffer train dropout with paired identical RNG and independent-mask control
resolved.calibration: fresh source-L heads200 plus old-pair gradient fixed calibration12; original identity unchanged
resolved.claim_scope: source controlled identity difficulty/gradient interaction; all source RX seen, not unknown-RX or target improvement proof
resolved.output_policy: exclusive new diagnostic output; statistics and source logs only; no checkpoints/IQ/maps saved
resolved.source_storage_note: Packed source cache co-deserializes V then discards without forward/fitting; U cache not loaded.

parent_provenance.checkpoint_selection: fixed final20; all original matrix rows evaluated
parent_provenance.method: pure CE, original gates/reference_response, cosine schedule
parent_provenance.selection_context: E20 now explicitly selected by user after target-informed epoch-budget exploration; exposed development benchmark, not a new blind confirmation

warmup.optimizer: fresh AdamW for heads only; discarded before main AdamW

calibration.sampling_namespace: calibration-private; distinct from training; cross-batch overlap allowed
